documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results
Board Meeting Outcome for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong financial performance in Q1 FY27 with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by operational rigor and disciplined cost management despite supply chain pressures. The company's construction equipment segment performed well due to infrastructure-led spending, while large agricultural equipment remained at a cyclical bottom with recovery expected later. Management maintains a healthy balance sheet with net cash of approximately INR190 crores and continues to evaluate value-accretive inorganic acquisition opportunities. Uniparts India reported its Q1 FY27 financial results with total income of INR 3,552 million, reflecting a year-on-year revenue growth of 27% and PAT growth of 64%. Management highlighted that the restoration of the Ludhiana facility's finishing shop is progressing on schedule and Mexico warehouse operations are on track for customer deliveries in Q3.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with a more meaningful recovery expected in calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: After three consecutive years of volume decline in small agriculture equipment, the company is beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the aftermarket segment to normalize and return to growth as tariffs have come down.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalize and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Large ag industry is expected to face mid-teens decline in 2026 before growth resumes in FY28.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year. And again, the growth will come in FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending under technology investments in the US and government-led spending in Europe are sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in small agriculture, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: For large agriculture, leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused aftermarket demand skewing, but normalisation is expected as tariffs have come down.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing. With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the third quarter of FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirmed that quarter 4 of FY26 represents a cyclical trough for large agricultural machinery.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: We also have the aftermarket sector, and the aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with the first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, focusing on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement, and customer-led growth initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure stood at INR12 crores for the fourth quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter stands at 33.3%, largely driven by product mix change.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains its cycle EBITDA margins over peak to trough at about 20%.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough. We maintain that.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Performance accounted for a INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: The company has maintained conscious cost discipline through the year.
margins_costs.quote: Second, we have maintained conscious cost discipline through the year.

margins_costs.claim: Management has consistently stated that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Construction equipment accounts for 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: On a trailing twelve-month basis, the new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt-free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow was INR52 crores in Q4 and INR174 crores in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Operating cash flow was INR52 crores in Q4 and INR174 crores in FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket business as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: One of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop towards the end of quarter 3.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fire incident is fully covered under the insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The incident is fully covered under our insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: The evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico warehouse operations will see first customer deliveries in Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims for acquisitions to be ROCE and ROE accretive within an 18 to 30-month span.
management_commitments.quote: We're also looking at something which is ROCE and ROE accretive to us within, let's say, an 18 to 30-months span.

management_commitments.claim: The aftermarket segment demand is expected to normalize over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And I think over the next 12 months, we do expect this to normalize.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the warehouse in Mexico are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects normal operations from the Ludhiana facility to return on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
